description_expanded: OverviewHot TubSteps to the PRIVATE beach-8 bikes-Private pool/Heat option & hot tub- In Seacrest WestThe Space Blanca Estate – Luxurious Gulf-View Retreat with Private Pool & Carriage House! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Private Pool, Hot Tub & Heat Option – Relax in style with a spillover spa & sun-drenched patio Wine Cellar & Wet Bar – Perfect for entertaining & unwinding Gulf Views from Expansive Balconies – Enjoy stunning sunsets just steps from the beach Interior & Exterior Fireplaces – Cozy up inside or by the outdoor firepit Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected while you unwind 8 FREE Adult Bikes – Cruise 30A & explore nearby Seacrest, Alys, & Rosemary Beach 100 Yards from Private Beach Access – Quick & easy stroll to sugar-white sands Driveway Parking for 6 Cars + 2 Gravel Spaces (Carriage House) – Plenty of room for guests Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest Service for a worry-free stay Pool Heating Available (Oct 1 – May 1) – $50/day for the duration of your stayWelcome to Blanca Estate"Blanca Estate" in Seacrest West distinguishes itself with elegance and sophistication. This recently completed home is spacious enough to accommodate 24 guests in its 8 bedrooms, 7 full bathrooms and 2 half baths between the main house and carriage house. The first floor features a master suite equipped with a fireplace, jacuzzi bathtub, double vanity and a walk-in shower adjacent to an open living area and kitchen. A serene kitchen with lovely white marble, a farmhouse sink, and premium appliances has everything guests need. Next to the kitchen is a second master suite with a king-sized bed and a walk-in shower and bath tub. Sliding glass doors open to a private pool and spillover spa. The back yard includes an exterior firepit, a gas grill, a dining table and plenty of seating to soak up some sun.Take the stairs or the elevator up to the second floor where you'll find an expansive balcony with 2 large porch swings. Continuing back inside is a guest room featuring a king-sized bed and en suite bathroom. Down the hall is a large bunk room with 2 queen over queen bunk beds, its own living room and private bathroom. Another guest room greets you with 2 queen sized beds and an en suite bathroom. You'll find a spacious living room and another guest room equipped with a queen-sized bed before heading up to the third floor.The third floor provides access to a wet bar, living area, wine fridge and plenty of seating for everyone. The balcony enjoys views of the gulf and access to a gas firepit. Located just steps from the beach, Hacienda Blanca is sure to accommodate all your vacation desires.The carriage house includes sleeping for 4 available between the 2 king bedrooms. Each bedroom has its own en suite bathroom with state-of-the-art standup showers. The open main living area includes a sitting area facing a large HDTV, a dinner table with seating for 2, and a brand-new kitchen including refrigerator, stove, oven, and microwave.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Pool Heat *Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay*Pool heat is not guaranteed-please note pool and hot tub cannot be heated at the same time.*Please choose to heat one option; pool or hot tub for your stay.*No Cable. Streaming Only**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (24):Main House -Master bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomMaster Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - 2 Queen sized beds, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - Queen sized bedBunk Room - 2 Queen over queen bunks, en suite bathroomCarriage House -Guest Room - King sized bed, en suite bathGuest Room - King sized bed, en suite bathAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.You can find historic Alys Beach 0.5 miles east. Slightly further east you can enjoy the lively community that gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
